name: @pipeworx/mcp-nl-rechtspraak

tools.name: nl_rechtspraak_search
tools.description: Search Dutch court decisions (uitspraken/conclusies) by court, legal domain (rechtsgebied), document type and decision-date range, paged. The source has no full-text search API; passing `query` filters client-side on each candidate's title and published abstract only (not the full decision text) across at most 200 of the most recently modified metadata-matching candidates — the response says when that scan was partial. Returns ECLIs that nl_rechtspraak_get_decision resolves to the full text.

query.description: Text to match against each candidate decision's title and published abstract (case-insensitive substring). NOT a search of the full decision body.

court.description: A currently sitting Dutch court's name or abbreviation, e.g. "Hoge Raad", "HR", "Rechtbank Amsterdam", "RBAMS" — or an exact creator identifier URI from data.rechtspraak.nl/Waardelijst/Instanties for a discontinued court.

subject.description: A rechtsgebied (legal domain) name from the Rechtspraak taxonomy, e.g. "Civiel recht", "Arbeidsrecht", "Strafrecht" — or its exact identifier URI.

type.description: Document type: "uitspraak" (judgment/ruling) or "conclusie" (advocate-general's opinion, Hoge Raad cassation cases only). Omit for both.

date_from.description: Decision date (uitspraakdatum) range start, ISO YYYY-MM-DD. With date_to, filters "from date_from through date_to" inclusive. Alone, filters to exactly that one date.

date_to.description: Decision date range end, ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Alone (no date_from), filters to exactly that one date.

tools.name: nl_rechtspraak_get_decision
tools.description: Read one Dutch court decision by its ECLI (e.g. "ECLI:NL:HR:2019:2006"): full original Dutch text, court, decision date, publication date and last-modified date as separate fields, procedure, rechtsgebied(en), formal relations to other ECLIs (e.g. earlier/later instance), and any BWB statute ids the source formally links (often empty — see cited_bwb_ids_note) for chaining to nl_wetten_get_law / nl_wetten_get_article.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-nl-rechtspraak forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the nl-rechtspraak pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
